review.verdict: Tanked the Bug Trio, Sartura and Ouro without dying, quiet on the rest
review.summary: You tanked on the Bug Trio (82), Sartura (83) and Ouro (87) with Titans every pull, and didn't die. As DPS the night was weak: Skeram 18 (mind-controlled once), Fankriss 3, the Twins 31 with 45 seconds of nothing at the start.

good.title: Tanking
good.text: Bug Trio, Sartura and Ouro, no deaths.

fix.title: Twin Emperors
fix.text: 31, nothing for the first 45 seconds.

fix.title: Fankriss
fix.text: 3; you took 13% of his melee, so you were tanking something.

review.verdict: Huhuran's Poison Bolt, then C'Thun's stomach
review.summary: Two deaths against your usual 0.3: Huhuran's Poison Bolt (8,566) killed you at 0:40 while soaking, the last of four soaker deaths, which took your world buffs, and on C'Thun the stomach's Digestive Acid got you at 3:06. Viscidus, Huhuran, Ouro and C'Thun (1) were all near the bottom.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Mongoose and Fortitude every pull, Titans, Nature Protection Potions for Huhuran.

fix.title: Huhuran soak
fix.text: Poison Bolt killed you at 0:40. Soakers need nature resistance and healing; this one cost your world buffs.

fix.title: C'Thun's stomach
fix.text: Digestive Acid killed you at 3:06. Leave before the stacks get high.
